newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board on Friday after the Central Bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to 10.25 from 10 percent, dealers said.
"This is in response to the increase in rates," a foreign bank trader said.

Dealers said the Central Bank increased its rate to stave off the peso's fall on talks the Philippines may suffer the same fate as Thailand. Thai banks faced a confidence crisis in early March on fears they were over-exposed to the property market.
